components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: 44px+ tactile primary action button in Electric Violet with Hyper Indigo hover and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #4B1FE0; background: var(--dz-action-bg, #6236FF); color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -6px rgba(98, 54, 255, 0.32); transition: background 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--dz-action-bg-hover, #4B1FE0); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4B1FE0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Volt Lime Order-Ready Banner
components.description: 15.3:1 AAA Volt Lime pickup alert banner with Midnight Indigo typography and acknowledge CTA.
components.html: Ding! Your food is ready. (A-042)Head to the pickup counter
components.css: .ds-ready-banner { background: var(--dz-ready-bg, #C8FF42); color: var(--dz-ready-fg, #17132E); border: 2px solid #17132E; border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px; display: grid; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -6px rgba(200, 255, 66, 0.50); } .ds-ready-top strong { display: block; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-ready-top span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-ready-ack { min-height: 46px; border-radius: 14px; border: none; background: #17132E; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease; } .ds-ready-ack:hover { background: #241E42; } .ds-ready-ack:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4B1FE0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search & Pager Code Input
components.description: Mobile-safe 16px+ input on Lilac Mist with 2px Hyper Indigo focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Enter receipt or pager # (A-001)" />
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; max-width: 300px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--dz-border-hairline, #E5E2F2); background: var(--dz-bg-subtle, #F6F5FC); color: var(--dz-ink-primary, #17132E); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #57507A; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #6236FF; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #4B1FE0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(75, 31, 224, 0.25); }

components.name: Capability Filter Chip
components.description: 44px pill chip in Iris Wash with Hyper Indigo text for selected venue/queue filters.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #C4B3FF; background: var(--dz-bg-tint, #EFEAFF); color: var(--dz-link-inline, #4B1FE0); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #6236FF; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #6236FF; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4B1FE0; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: dingzi pairs upbeat consumer-tech clarity with tactile café hospitality. Daylight guest screens stay bright, airy, and glare-resistant on Lilac Mist and Pure White, while counter Order Prep tablets anchor on Midnight Indigo and Cosmic Slate to eliminate eye strain during long shifts. Every transition builds toward one unmistakable sensory payoff: the Volt Lime ready flash and rising fifth chime.
keyCharacteristics: 60–25–10–5 proportion balance across canvas, ink, Electric Violet actions, and Volt Lime ready states.
Strict lowercase dingzi wordmark paired with the 25-degree tilted Volt Ringer squircle.
Native bilingual symmetry (LTR English + RTL Arabic) with tabular monospace queue codes.

rules.name: The Zero-Gold, Zero-Black Rule
rules.body: Never introduce metallic gold, brass, warm amber, or pure #000000 tuxedo black on any screen, QR plaque, or receipt.

rules.name: The Volt Surface Rule
rules.body: Volt Lime is strictly a surface fill or dark-surface accent; always pair #C8FF42 fills with #17132E ink and never render Volt Lime text on white.

rules.name: The Lowercase Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Always set dingzi in all-lowercase (-0.03em tracking) and دِنغزي in Arabic.

dos: Do keep tenant menu themes (plum, ocean, terracotta, custom hex) 100% intact on /v/:slug and /menu/:id with only a 0.65-opacity monochrome Powered by dingzi footer stamp.
Do pair every order, table, and coaster state with icon + text label + color and tabular-nums monospace codes.
donts: Don't capitalize dingzi, unbox or recolor the 25-degree Volt Ringer bell, or use gradient text (background-clip: text).
Don't use emojis as UI icons, animate-bounce, or interactive targets smaller than 44x44px.
